methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date; monthlyUsd records the month-to-month rate in USD with the annual-billing monthly rate and annualDiscountPct noted where published. Per-seat/enterprise per-user pricing is flagged in notes; quote-only or contact-sales tiers carry monthlyUsd null. Every figure is sourced to the provider pricing page, with a dedicated 2026 pricing-review recorded as corroboration where prices render client-side; minutes/calls/overage and HIPAA/BAA do not apply to course platforms and are null.
